title: National Parks Fell To 323 Million Visits After Shutdown
hook: A record year became 323 million visits after shutdown.
closing: Public access can disappear quickly, even when demand for parks remains strong.
question: Which national park would you visit?

segments.say: National parks reached 331.9 million visits. The new record showed demand was still climbing.
National park visits fell to 323 million. Shutdown disruption erased the record year's gain.
Blue Ridge Parkway drew 16.5 million visits. Even amid disruption, the most popular site kept pulling crowds.
